newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA REPORTS 506 BANK ROBBERIES IN 10 MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA REPORTS 506 BANK ROBBERIES IN 10 MONTHS.

text.p: South African Minister of Safety and Security Sydney Mufamadi told parliament on Tuesday that 506 banks were robbed in the 10 months to the end of 1996.
The highest number of robberies was reported in Gauteng, around Johannesburg, where 193 banks were robbed, he said in a written response to a question.
Ninety three banks were robbed in KwaZulu-Natal, 48 in Northwest province, 45 in the Eastern Cape and 28 in the Western Cape.
